title: The Kalopaideia Diploma in Reading Old English — Capstone Examination
instructions: Three hours, printed lexicon and grammar permitted. Honor code: you affirm by submitting that you used only permitted aids. A failed examination may be retaken after thirty days.

items.prompt_oldenglish: Hwæt! Wē Gār-Dena in gēardagum, þēodcyninga, þrym gefrūnon.
reference: Lo! We have heard of the glory of the Spear-Danes in days of yore, of the people-kings.
Listen! We of the Spear-Danes in ancient days have heard of the glory of the people-kings.
Behold! We have heard the glory of the Spear-Danes' people-kings in days gone by.

items.prompt_oldenglish: Nū sculon herigean heofonrīces Weard, Metodes meahte and his mōdgeþanc.
reference: Now we must praise the Guardian of the heavenly kingdom, the might of the Creator and his thought.
Now we should praise the Keeper of heaven's kingdom, the power of the Maker and his mind.
Now must we praise heaven-kingdom's Guardian, the Measurer's might and his purpose.

items.prompt_oldenglish: Ælfred kyning hāteþ grētan Wærferþ biscep his wordum luflīce and frēondlīce.
items.prompt_en: Translate. (Alfred's Preface to the Pastoral Care)
reference: King Alfred commands Bishop Werferth to be greeted with his words lovingly and in friendship.
King Alfred sends loving and friendly greetings in his words to Bishop Werferth.
Alfred the king bids greet Bishop Werferth with his words lovingly and amicably.

items.prompt_oldenglish: On anginne gesceōp God heofonan and eorþan. Sēo eorþe wæs īdel and ǣmtig.
reference: In the beginning God created heaven and earth. The earth was idle and empty.
In the beginning God shaped the heavens and the earth. The earth was void and empty.
At the start God created heaven and earth. The earth was waste and vacant.
